name: Shin Hwa World Limited
summary: Shin Hwa World Ltd. operates as an investment holding company that specializes in the creation and management of integrated leisure and entertainment resorts. The firm's business scope also extends to operating gaming and amusement facilities, as well as property development initiatives. Its activities are organized into distinct divisions: Integrated Resort Development, Gaming Business, and Property Development. The company was established in Hong Kong on October 30, 2001.
